title: AI Factory app proposal (contract C2)
description: Mirror of the Management App's shared app-proposal schema (appProposalSchema, schemaVersion 1). The quick scan writes source quick-scan; this agent writes source replatform-agent; the Wizard agent writes source wizard-agent. A proposal is never a final value: a person applies it in the Wizard's Apps step and approves the settings. It is kept in step with the pinned contracts/mgmt/app-proposal.schema.json.

notes.description: What the analysis could not decide, in plain words.

name.description: The Wizard's app name rule: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, at most 10 characters.

root.description: The folder the app was found in, relative to the package root; empty for the root.

port.description: Null when nothing in the code names one.

secret.description: True for the names that belong in Key Vault. Names only, never values.

path.description: A file in the assessed repository, relative to the package root. Never file content.

note.description: What was read there and why it decides the value.
